# A bush (generated by make_env.py), 1.6 m across.
new
material new Leaf --base-color 0.165 0.345 0.310 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Ball0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.6 --location 0 0 0.42
material assign Leaf
add mesh ico-sphere --name Ball1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.42 --location -0.55 0.1 0.29
material assign Leaf
add mesh ico-sphere --name Ball2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.45 --location 0.55 -0.1 0.32
material assign Leaf
select all
shade flat
export bush.glb
